ranked_hypotheses.name: Monogenic Cross-Spectral Phase-Congruent Structural Conduit + Out-of-Quadrant Geothermal Fault-Intersection Specialist with Exact Submodular CELF Kernel Allocation
external_pinned_layers: lidar_scarp_features_u8.tif (step_max, cross_max, coh100, downface_max, upface_max, lapneg_max, lappos_max; valid and strike excluded)
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: 2-D Riesz-transform monogenic phase congruency across dyadic scales sigma in {1.5, 3.0, 6.0} px on RTP and isostatic gravity (strictly invariant to contrast amplitude), TMI-vs-TMI_up150 upward-continuation structural decay, hydrothermal magnetite-destruction troughs inside gravity phase steps, Hessian-eccentricity conductive fault-gouge necks, Lahontan-deconfounded K/Th-U/Th metasomatic gradients, structure-tensor fault-intersection determinant (det J / tr J), and 3DEP LiDAR/fluvial-chi scarps fused via 4-fold Leave-One-Quadrant-Out (LOQO) spatial cross-fitting with fold-visible Pollard-Segall crack-tip lobes and allocated by exact CELF submodular marginal kernel credit.
ranked_hypotheses.why_catalogue_missing: Mapped USGS/INGENIOUS traces over-represent high-relief bedrock range fronts where amplitude gradients are strong. Concealed intra-basin accommodation faults, blind geothermal stepovers (>75% of Great Basin hydrothermal systems lack surface springs; Faulds & Hinz 2015), and weakly magnetized tuff/alluvium relays attenuate potential-field amplitude 5x-20x while preserving multi-scale Riesz odd-symmetry phase alignment, linear smectite/brine conductance necks, and K/U metasomatic halos.
ranked_hypotheses.novelty_vs_repo: First executable 2-D Riesz monogenic phase congruency + TMI_up150 vertical attenuation + structure-tensor fault-intersection geothermal conduit model in GEMSDOE86; strips all raw regional elevation/gravity/magnetic background levels to prevent mountain-range memorization, enforces strict 4-fold LOQO spatial cross-fitting on both blind and kinematic specialists, and replaces static E[k] spacing-greedy / tile decimation with exact O(N log N) heap-accelerated CELF submodular marginal DTI-numerator updates.
ranked_hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Buried Tertiary caldera ring-fracture walls or welded ash-flow tuff cooling-unit pinch-outs altered by fossil Miocene epithermal systems, and Pleistocene Lake Lahontan highstand (~1,330 m) wave-cut benches adjacent to saline playas.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement_qualitative: Highest expected joint gain on both OOF buffered whole-component HOLDOUT-DTI and off-catalogue SGMC-PROXY-DTI at fixed 37,654-dot fleet budget by eliminating regional-level overfitting and sub-kernel double counting.
ranked_hypotheses.implementation_cost: Medium (pure CPU NumPy/SciPy/scikit-learn + O(N log N) heapq CELF; ~8-12 min runtime, zero new unpinned external downloads).

ranked_hypotheses.name: Upward-Continuation Wavenumber Attenuation Structural Index (TMI vs TMI_up150) for Intra-Graben Faults
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Logarithmic vertical decay rate z0 * d/dz ln|grad TMI| between flight-level RTP/TMI and 150 m upward-continued TMI_up150 to isolate sub-vertical fault-contact structural indices (N ~ 0.5-1.0) from surficial basalt clinker (N >= 2.5) and deep plutons (N -> 0).
ranked_hypotheses.why_catalogue_missing: Intra-graben synthetic/antithetic accommodation faults beneath 100-400 m basin fill have zero topographic expression.
ranked_hypotheses.novelty_vs_repo: Avoids noisy third-order Euler deconvolution derivatives (GEMSDOE40: 0.0355-0.0984) by using exact upward-continuation attenuation; core attenuation operator folded into H86J-MCSP.
ranked_hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Shallow sub-vertical Miocene basaltic feeder dikes.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement_qualitative: Moderate standalone; high value as an orthogonal depth-discrimination plane inside a multi-physics specialist.

ranked_hypotheses.name: Anisotropic Drainage-Divide Chi-Asymmetry Coupled with Crustal Transtensional Strain-Rate Alignment
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Cross-divide fluvial chi-step asymmetry gated by active geodetic transtensional shear-dilation product to detect distributed Walker Lane / Humboldt tilt-block boundaries lacking continuous scarps.
ranked_hypotheses.why_catalogue_missing: Distributed transtensional shear zones accommodate slip across unmapped bedrock-pediment block tilts.
ranked_hypotheses.novelty_vs_repo: Couples cross-divide chi disequilibrium with GPS/InSAR strain invariants rather than raw chi thresholding (60GEMSDOE: 0.0351).
ranked_hypotheses.named_non_fault_mimic: Differential bedrock erodibility across unfaulted granite-tuff contacts.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement_qualitative: Low-to-moderate standalone because uplift transients span 1-3 km across strike, wider than the 300 m kernel.

ranked_hypotheses.name: Hessian-Eccentricity Conductive Fault-Gouge Necking Deconfounded from Isotropic Evaporite Playas
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Linear negative-curvature ridges of electrical conductivity weighted by Hessian eigenvalue eccentricity (|lambda_1| - |lambda_2|)/(|lambda_1| + |lambda_2|) and suppressed on zero-slope deep-basin centers.
ranked_hypotheses.why_catalogue_missing: Active hydrothermal brine/smectite conduits in basin interiors (Brady/Dixie Valley style) are buried by Holocene playa silt.
ranked_hypotheses.novelty_vs_repo: Explicit Hessian eccentricity gating rejects equant saline playas that confounded earlier conductivity models (GEMSDOE65: 0.0431); incorporated as a specialist feature inside H86J-MCSP.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_improvement_qualitative: Low standalone due to coarse conductivity resolution, moderate synergistic lift at fault intersections.
